stem: The area, in square centimeters, covered by mold on a slice of bread \(d\) days after the mold was first observed is modeled by \(A(d) = 1.5(2)^{d}\). According to the model, what is the area, in square centimeters, covered by mold 3 days after it was first observed?
verify:
d = symbols('d')
A = Lambda(d, Rational(3, 2)*2**d)
assert A(3) == 12
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [A(3)]
